## Checklist

<!-- For repo tooling / docs PRs, the example-specific boxes are n/a. -->

- [ ] The example lives in its own self-contained directory.
- [ ] It has a README that a reader can follow start-to-finish in under five minutes.
- [ ] It runs against **testnet** and needs no credentials beyond a user-supplied API key.
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or `.env` files are committed (`.env.example` only).
- [ ] It pins the SDK/CLI version it targets, and the README names that version.
- [ ] CI is green — every example is built/typechecked on every PR.
